mission.hypothesis: For small active grids, the original serial path avoids OpenMP startup. For larger work, a one-thread budget uses a region per timestep to expose its six-region overhead against the serial baseline, while larger budgets keep one team across all timesteps to limit startup cost and test static row-level scaling. The output math and boundary writes remain unchanged; the controller must measure and verify both paths.

retained: Preserved the serial stencil and output initialization; route small active workloads through the serial implementation.
Added a shared row kernel and static OpenMP work sharing over collapsed z/y row loops.
Use a separate parallel region per timestep for larger one-thread calls and a persistent team across all six timesteps for multi-thread calls, with num_threads set from the call budget.
